positions.name: IdlessSubmissionPipelineRequirement
positions.frame: what must the pipeline do when a memory arrives without an explicit id field?
positions.why: src-1 establishes the precondition (no explicit id was given) and src-2 states the pipeline's required response to that precondition (produce a slug via id-gen or slugify fallback, then commit) — together they read as one scenario: absence-of-id triggers a mandated fallback behavior. The register and conviction reads support this coupling: src-1 is a flat factual claim about the artifact's state, src-2 is a decision-grade operational rule ('must produce', 'commit the file successfully') that only makes sense as a response to the condition src-1 names — the tension between claim and decision is part of the same read, not a contradiction to resolve.
